apply.ax.no_range: the field reports no selection range
apply.ax.not_settable: the field does not accept a direct write
apply.ax.unconfirmed: the app did not confirm the new text
apply.clipboard: the clipboard holds data Retone cannot restore
apply.modifiers: a modifier key is held down
apply.no_target: Retone cannot check where the text came from
apply.secure_field: the field is a password field
apply.secure_input: another app has secure keyboard input on
capture.clipboard: The clipboard holds data Retone cannot restore. Copy the text with ⌘C, then press your shortcut.
capture.modifiers: Release the shortcut keys, then try again.
capture.own_window: Select text in another app, then press your shortcut.
capture.secure_input: Another app has secure keyboard input on, so Retone cannot copy the selection.
capture.unreadable: Retone could not read the selected text. Try again, or copy it with ⌘C first.
claude.relative_config_dir: CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR must be an absolute path, so Retone did not run Claude Code.
cli.not_found: Cannot run {{name}}. Is it installed? If Terminal finds it, enter its full path in Settings → Provider → Program.
cli.not_verified: {{name}} {{found}} is not verified for no-history use. {{supported}} Choose another provider or keep a verified version.
cli.version_failed: {{name}} was found but did not start: {{error}}
consent.disabled: {{provider}} saved files during this rewrite, so Retone turned it off. Nothing was deleted. Files may be in {{folder}}.
consent.free_model: Free models can have different privacy terms and limits.
consent.network: Send the selected text to {{provider}} on {{host}} / {{model}}? It leaves this Mac over your network.
consent.plain_http: Plain http is not encrypted: use Tailscale or https on a shared network.
consent.question: Send the selected text to {{provider}} / {{model}}?
input.no_text_help: Select some text, then press your shortcut again.
input.secure_field_help: Retone does not read or change password fields.
input.too_long_help: {{chars}} characters. Retone rewrites up to {{limit}} at a time. Select a shorter part and try again.
local.bad_answer: The local server sent an answer Retone does not understand.
local.failed: The request to the local server failed.
local.needs_network: Turn on "Allow LAN and Tailscale servers" to use an address outside this Mac.
local.not_private: Retone accepts only addresses on this Mac or on a private network (LAN or Tailscale), so it did not send the text.
local.public: Retone accepts only addresses on this Mac or on a private network (LAN or Tailscale).
local.scheme: Use an http:// or https:// address, such as http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1.
local.tls: The secure connection failed. Check the server's certificate, or use http:// on Tailscale.
local.unauthorized: The server needs an API key (llama-server --api-key), or the key is wrong. Set it in Settings → Provider.
local.unreachable: Cannot reach the local server. Is Ollama, LM Studio, llama-server or Llama.app running?
local.user_name: The address must not contain a user name.
opencode.config_failed: Retone could not prepare OpenCode's private config.
popup.consent.note: Retone asks once per provider and model. Revoke it in Settings → Privacy.
popup.consent.title: Allow this provider?
popup.hint.empty: Some models return nothing for a very short or unusual text. Retry, try another style, or switch model.
popup.hint.other: Retry, or switch to another provider or model.
popup.hint.setup: Fix this in Settings → Provider, or switch to another provider.
popup.hint.timeout: A large model can be slow, or still loading. Retry in a moment, or switch to a smaller model.
popup.hint.too_long: Retone rewrites text: it does not answer it, follow it or open links. Select only the text to rewrite, or try another style.
popup.hint.too_long_local: Retone rewrites text: it does not answer it, follow it or open links. Try another style, or a recommended model such as {{model}}.
popup.hint.unreachable: Start the local server, then press Retry. Or switch to another provider.
popup.more.label: More styles
popup.more.spoken_hint: Arrow keys choose, Return uses, Escape goes back.
popup.note.clipboard_only: Accessibility is off, so Retone used the clipboard, not the selection. Grant it in Settings.
popup.note.copy_only: Retone cannot replace text in this app or field, so only Copy is offered.
popup.note.dropped: Retone dropped this answer because it is far longer than your text: it can answer the text instead of rewriting it, or be cut off. Only Copy is offered.
popup.note.from_clipboard: Nothing was selected, so Retone used the clipboard text. Only Copy is offered.
popup.note.from_service: Retone cannot check this field again before a write, so only Copy is offered. With Accessibility on, Replace works when the text is still selected.
popup.note.streaming: Still writing… Copy and Replace turn on when the answer is complete.
popup.note.too_long: This is more than twice as long as your text. Press ⌘R to try again.
popup.picker.empty: No provider is set up. Open Settings → Provider.
popup.picker.hint_loading: Loading local models…   ↑↓ choose   ⏎ use   Esc back
popup.picker.label: Providers
popup.picker.spoken_hint: Arrow keys choose, Return uses, Escape goes back.
popup.picker.spoken_hint_loading: Loading local models. Arrow keys choose, Return uses, Escape goes back.
popup.spoken.dropped: Dropped answer shown. Press Return to copy it.
popup.spoken.ready_copy: Rewrite ready. Press ⌘C to copy it.
popup.spoken.ready_replace: Rewrite ready. Press Return to replace it, or ⌘C to copy it.
provider.exact_model: Choose an exact {{name}} model ID in Settings.
provider.temp_folder: Retone could not create its temp folder.
provider.too_long: The answer was far longer than your text, so Retone dropped it.
settings.access.off_help: Off: clipboard-only mode. Copy the text with ⌘C, then press your shortcut.
settings.access.on_help: On: Retone reads the selection and can replace it.
settings.access.title: Accessibility
settings.address.help_local: This Mac only. For LAN or Tailscale, turn on the switch on the Provider page.
settings.address.help_network: This Mac, or a private address on your LAN or Tailscale. http or https.
settings.address.save_note: Click Save on the Provider page to keep the change.
settings.address.title: Address
settings.after_update_help: Turn Retone off and on in the Accessibility list, or remove it and add it again.
settings.api_key.help: For llama-server --api-key. Kept in the Keychain, never shown again.
settings.api_key.title: API key
settings.default_style_help: The style the popup starts with.
settings.diagnostics_help: Start Retone with RETONE_SPIKE_LOG=1 to print capture and replace steps. It never prints text.
settings.login_help: Open Retone when you log in to this Mac.
settings.models.empty: The server has no models. Pull one first.
settings.models.title: Server models
settings.network.off_help: Off: only addresses on this Mac.
settings.network.on_help: Private addresses such as 192.168.1.20 or box.tailnet.ts.net. Plain http is not encrypted: use Tailscale or https on a shared network.
settings.network.title: Allow LAN and Tailscale servers
settings.privacy.consent_help: Retone asks before it first sends text to each provider.
settings.privacy.history_help: Selected and rewritten text stays in memory and is never saved.
settings.privacy.revoked: Retone will ask again before the next rewrite with each provider.
settings.provider.claude_how: Runs claude -p with no session files, tools, MCP servers or hooks.
settings.provider.codex_how: Runs codex exec --ephemeral in a read-only sandbox with tools and memories off.
settings.provider.help_cli: A command-line agent, run with no history in a private temp folder.
settings.provider.help_local: An OpenAI-compatible server: Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp or Llama.app.
settings.provider.help_none: Retone sends nothing until you choose a provider.
settings.provider.key_removed: API key removed from the Keychain.
settings.provider.model_help: Use 3B or larger, such as qwen2.5:3b: smaller models often ignore the style.
settings.provider.not_verified: Not verified yet: Retone refuses it until the history check passes.
settings.provider.opencode_how: Runs opencode run with its database in memory and tools off. Free models can have other privacy terms.
settings.provider.program_help: Optional. Retone finds {{program}} through your login shell and the usual install folders. If {{name}} is not found, enter its full path, such as /opt/homebrew/bin/{{program}}.
settings.provider.program_invalid: The {{name}} program {{path}} is not a file. Enter a full path, such as /opt/homebrew/bin/{{program}}, or leave it empty.
settings.provider.saved_none: No provider: the shortcut shows "Choose a provider".
settings.recommended.fastest: Fastest: 0.6 s a rewrite, 2.6 GB of memory. Passed 92% of the checks; Expand is sometimes too short.
settings.recommended.help: Small models that passed Retone's style checks on a Mac.
settings.recommended.note: Tested with scripts/model-bench.sh on an Apple M1 Max. Use fills in the ID for this server; click Save on the Provider page to keep it. In LM Studio, download the model by its Hugging Face name, then choose it with List.
settings.recommended.quality: Best quality: 1.2 s a rewrite, 5.3 GB of memory. Passed 99% of the checks and invented no details.
settings.recommended.smallest: Smallest download: a 2.0 GB file, 0.7 s a rewrite, 3.4 GB of memory. Passed 90% of the checks.
settings.recommended.title: Recommended models
settings.services.hide_help: In Keyboard, click Keyboard Shortcuts, then Services › Text, and turn off the Retone items.
settings.services.off_help: Off: Retone ignores these items. macOS still shows them until you hide them below.
settings.services.on_help: Retone: Fix Spelling and Grammar, Improve Writing, Summarize, Bullet Points and TL;DR in the right-click menu of apps that support Services.
settings.services.title: Right-click menu (macOS Services)
settings.shortcut.help_set: Works in every app and replaces that app's own use of it.
settings.shortcut.help_unset: Record one to start. Until then, use Rewrite Selection in the menu bar.
settings.shortcut.help_voiceover: Works in every app and replaces that app's own use of it. With VoiceOver on, press VO-Tab first.
settings.shortcut.title: Rewrite shortcut
settings.styles.built_in_help: Tones (Clear, Concise, Professional, Technical, Simplify) and actions (Fix, Summarize, Expand, Bullets, TL;DR), each with its own rules and example.
settings.styles.custom_help: Your own instruction, as one more style.
settings.styles.instruction_help: Say what to change, such as tone or length. Retone keeps the meaning and the language.
settings.styles.shortcut_help: Opens the popup in this style.
settings.styles.shortcut_help_voiceover: Opens the popup in this style. With VoiceOver on, press VO-Tab first.
settings.test.idle: Check that the shortcut reaches Retone.
settings.test.title: Test the shortcut
updates.homebrew: Homebrew installed Retone. Update it with: brew upgrade --cask retone
updates.manual: This build has no automatic updates. Download new versions from github.com/jellydn/retone/releases.
updates.sparkle: Retone checks for updates automatically and asks before it installs one.
